case_name: Smt.Dr Rohini W/O Shivagouda Patil vs Shri Dr Shivagouda S/O Malagouda Patil

parties.respondent_defendant: Shri Dr Shivagouda S/o Malagouda Patil, husband

facts_of_case: Petitioner and respondent were married in 2014. Differences arose between them, and the petitioner stopped residing with the respondent at their marital home. The respondent filed a petition for dissolution of marriage under Section 13(1) (ia) (ib) of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 read with Section 7(I) (A) of the Family Courts Act, 1984. The petitioner has now filed this civil petition seeking transfer of the case to Vijayapur.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking transfer to show that it is necessary and justifiable.
legal_principles.held: Having heard the learned counsel for the parties and on perusal of the material on record

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking transfer must show that it is necessary and justifiable.
legal_principles.held: Having heard the learned counsel for the parties and on perusal of the material on record

outcome.final_order: The court ordered the transfer of M.C.No.377/2016 pending on the file of Judge, Family Court, Belagavi to the court of Judge, Family Court, Vijayapur.

use_for_drafting: drafting a transfer petition in a divorce case
advising on the judge's discretion in transferring a family court matter
